anonymity.title: Protect your anonymity
anonymity.description: Never share your full name, phone number, address, email, or other identifying details in a circle — yours or anyone else's.

noAdvertising.title: No advertising or soliciting
noAdvertising.description: Don't promote a business, service, or product, and don't ask other users to pay for anything.

noEndorsements.title: No endorsements or recommendations
noEndorsements.description: Don't recommend or endorse specific practitioners, treatments, or outside services. This isn't a referral space.

supportDontDirect.title: Support, don't direct
supportDontDirect.description: Share your own experience, not medical or legal advice. Listening is always enough.

reportOrLeave.title: Report or leave anytime
reportOrLeave.description: If something feels wrong, or you're in crisis, use Report or Crisis resources right away. Nobody has to explain why they left.

guidelinesModal.nonNegotiable: These rules are non-negotiable and apply to every circle. Breaking them can get a session ended or an account removed.
guidelinesModal.understandAnonymous: I understand circles are anonymous by default
guidelinesModal.readAndAgreeToThePrefix: I have read and agree to the
guidelinesModal.liabilityNote: and accept that MinCirklen is not liable for advice or outcomes shared in a circle

reportModal.title: Report this session
reportModal.description: Tell us what happened. Your report goes to a moderator and stays anonymous — nobody in the circle is notified.
reportModal.nobodyElseJoined: Nobody else has joined this session yet.
reportModal.submitted: Report about {{about}} submitted — a moderator will review it.
reportModal.submitError: Something went wrong submitting your report. Please try again.

accountModal.profileUnavailable: Your profile isn't available right now.
accountModal.mobileHint: Mobile number is used only for account safety — never shown in a circle.
accountModal.stayAnonymousHint: Other users see "Anonymous," not your name
accountModal.privacyNote: Your name and contact details are encrypted at rest and never shown to other members — circles only ever see an anonymous label unless you've chosen to show your name.
accountModal.trainingConsentHint: Off by default — turn this on only if you're comfortable with your messages being used to train our AI
accountModal.trainingConsentInfo: We use anonymized messages to train and improve our AI moderation — this helps us catch what matters and makes the platform safer and better for everyone here, not just you.
accountModal.dataExportHint: Get a copy of your profile, messages, and account activity in a machine-readable format.
accountModal.dataExportPreparing: Preparing your export — this can take a few minutes.
accountModal.dataExportFailed: Something went wrong preparing this export.
accountModal.dataExportRequestFailed: Something went wrong requesting your data. Please try again.
accountModal.dataExportDownloadFailed: Something went wrong starting the download. Please try again.
accountModal.deleteAccountHint: Permanently delete your account and everything tied to it. This can't be undone.
accountModal.deleteAccountConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your profile, messages, and account activity. This cannot be undone.
accountModal.deleteAccountFailed: Something went wrong deleting your account. Please try again.
accountModal.preferencesUnavailable: Your preferences aren't available right now.

emptyState.ended: This session has ended. Transcripts are only visible to users during the live round.
emptyState.forming: This circle has not started yet. You will be notified when the round begins.

crisisModal.title: You're not alone right now
crisisModal.notice: What you shared here stays between you and our team — nobody else in the group will see it. Someone will take a look afterward, in case this didn't need to be held back.

centerPanelError.fullMessage: This circle has already reached its capacity.
centerPanelError.genericMessage: We couldn't load this session right now. Please try again.

errors.messageHeld: Your message was held for review and was not sent to the circle.
errors.sendFailed: Something went wrong sending that message.
errors.skipFailed: Something went wrong skipping your turn.
errors.sessionLoadFailed: Could not load this session right now.
errors.earlierMessagesLoadFailed: Could not load earlier messages right now.
